decisions.reason: As an award-winning geothermal probe that builds directly on our established offer and technical strengths, it is very likely to stay in the portfolio.
This single-U geothermal probe sensibly complements our system range and customer-specific energy solutions, so we would generally keep it despite limited visible market evidence.
The surface technology supports differentiation and performance in geothermal applications and fits our materials expertise, though it is somewhat more exposed to niche-demand rationalization.
A fire-protection steel profile system is close to our core building-systems business and serves regulation-driven customer needs, making retention likely.
The slim steel profile system extends our established steel profile range for construction customers and aligns well with our customized solutions strategy.
The decorative steel profile surface system fits our core offer but is a more discretionary variant, so it is slightly more likely to be streamlined than the more technical profile systems.
